annotations.title: Caps on what Meta rules may raise

description: The ad account's caps on automated rules: the most a rule may raise one budget/bid in a day (default 100%), the most rules may add to budgets in a day, and the highest budget a rule may set. A rule whose worst case breaks them cannot be switched on. Tightening needs nothing; LOOSENING needs confirm:true. The reply names any rule already ON that now exceeds them (Meta keeps running it until switched off). Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_… or the bare number) from list_meta_ads; required — every rule lives on one ad account

confirm.description: required when this LOOSENS a cap (tightening never needs it)

maxBudget.description: no rule may raise a budget above this, account currency; null = no cap

maxRaiseAmountPerDay.description: the most rules may ADD to budgets across the account in a day, account currency; null = no cap

maxRaisePercentPerDay.description: the most rules may raise ONE budget or bid in a day, percent (default 100); null removes it

name: set_meta_ad_rule_limits
